product.bolt_installation: two 3/8-inch structural through bolts per leg

applicability.capacity_gap: public A66 tables list the bolt installation but show no allowable load values for that bolt configuration; do not borrow the nailed A-angle values
applicability.geometry_gap: the 1.5-inch leg and four-bolt joint pattern require station-specific edge, end, washer, access, and withdrawal checks

decision: Use A66 as the common-retail procurement and representative-joint prototype candidate. Keep AB90 and Würth C1 as documented alternatives, but do not issue a purchase, drilling, or structural acceptance release until A66 bolt resistance and all 24 station fits are established.
